author: 刘柏坤
official_stage_narrative: Font review by author: submitted original lacks stroke-weight balance; internal 尚/口 too weak, 院/阝 overly simplified, 院 hooks and strokes rigid; modified version tries to maintain vertical proportions and shape while refining structure and wordmark balance.

validation_boundary.interpretation: Matched author-posted revised version on one obvious stage pair. This is ONE retrospective partially masked calibration sample, not a prospective independent blind aesthetic prediction.
confounds: A black polished lettering with integrated Latin lockup vs B orange outline/construction notes and red guides—stage can be inferred from appearance.
Source publication describes both stages; evaluator knew it was a before-and-after study.
Glyph groups are not fully normalized for color, ink size and secondary layout; ranking includes application-fit scores.
User has not given independent preference or confirmed character correctness; no outside panel.
Author revision is an editorial choice, not universal quality gold standard.
validation_boundary.image_raw_bytes_SHA: NOT_RETRIEVED; native widths/heights observed in connected browser but original image files not downloaded

failure_and_learning.demonstrated: A score rubric can be frozen and score submitted before unmasking, with a cryptographic mapping commitment and real author-backed reveal.
failure_and_learning.not_demonstrated: Ability to rank two subtly different, equally finished and equally legible professional designs without stage cues.
failure_and_learning.next_valid_test: Obtain same-text, same-color, equal-size, valid Chinese glyph alternatives from independent authors with hidden selection; use 3+ previously unseen cases, blind the reviewer and commit all predictions before opening outcome labels. If unavailable, do not report predictive accuracy.
failure_and_learning.stop_rule: Do not generate new glyphs until reviewer accuracy is tested on plausible same-stage alternatives with actual human selection criteria. Do not claim one matched easy case is success.
